issue_request: FHIR-7961 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 OO change request asking that the Substance.type property be renamed because "type" did not clearly describe the substance identity; the final resolution was to change it to Substance.code.
initial_application: The change appears to have been applied in git commit 7e22e5f2f59444e875ad6a9fcf3e425a8e280064, which explicitly says "#7961 change .type to .code" and changed the historical Substance spreadsheet from Substance.type/SubstanceType/substance-type to Substance.code/SubstanceCode/substance-code. Later source refactors moved Substance into the current StructureDefinition XML while preserving the #7961 committee note on Substance.code.
additional_context: The current build includes Substance as an active resource in source/fhir.ini. Current source has Substance.code as the required identifying element, code-based search parameters use Substance.code.concept and Substance.code.reference, and a current tracked-source grep found no remaining Substance.type element path. The same 2015 implementation commit also applied FHIR-7962 for Substance.category, but that issue is already represented on the combined branch and does not require another commit here. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant discussion or conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the active current Substance source already carries the requested type-to-code rename and the old Substance.type path is absent from tracked current source.
